title: Chapter 739: The Drunken Spirit Is Still Full Of Courage! (Down)
content:
Chapter 739: The Drunken Spirit Is Still Full Of Courage! (Down)

"Are those who hold the title of prince, general or prime minister born with a good life and a noble family!?"

Many people have heard this famous saying of Heifu, but they are all subconsciously surprised:

"Although the Qin army can be promoted to a noble title and gain famous fields, the civilian titles are not as powerful as those of public officials. Aren't princes, generals and ministers born with the talent?"

Since the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period, noble families have declined and scholars have risen. However, although the foundation of the feudal lords and ministers has been shaken, it has not collapsed. Although the commoner generals and prime ministers have taken shape, they are still not the mainstream, especially after unification. There were almost no channels for scholars to enter the central government of Qin Dynasty.

However, Hei Fu is the biggest exception in the world!

He patted his chest and said, "I was once the chief of Guizhou and the chief of the pavilion. I only had a name but no family name, but now, I am the Marquis of Che and the Marquis of Wuzhong of the Qin Dynasty!"

Isn’t it just lower than the starting point? Who is Heifu afraid of? Therefore, he is more qualified to shout this declaration than Chen Sheng of Youshi!

Hei Fu pointed at Dongmen Leopard again: "Dongmen Leopard, he was once a white apprentice who worked hard in the market, but now he is the fifth doctor and a dignified captain!"

"Ji Ying, he was once regarded as an idler by the people in the village, but now he is also a public official and has become the postal inspector of the three armies!"

"The same goes for Xiao Tao, Li Xian and others. They all started from humble beginnings, but now they have become wealthy. My bold words that day, our dream, have come true."

"So this sentence, I am not only saying to my old friends in Paoze, but also to you and everyone in the world!"

"A general has no talent, but a man should strengthen himself!"

"Don't you want to realize such a dream?"

Heifu's words were loud and clear, but more than three thousand people just remained silent and looked at each other in confusion.

"Why don't you speak?"

Heifu smiled: "Do you think you don't have the ability to get rich?"

Of course, he is not incompetent. Lu Jia was also listening from the outside. He felt that his ability was outstanding and his eloquence was comparable to that of Confucius's disciple Zigong: The two countries fought together in the fields of Jiangyang. The two bases faced each other, and the dust touched each other. , fighting with swords, he can wear silk clothes and white crowns, and during the presentation, he can deduce the pros and cons and relieve the country's troubles!

He was also very conceited when it came to writing books, thinking that he could do better than those Ph.D. historians who were just eating nothing!

When he went out, he would be a traveler, and when he entered, he would establish a sect. But for such a person, under the rule of the Qin Dynasty for ten years, he could not find a way to join the ranks. He could only be a poor scholar who was suppressed by the government, and was sent to the army. The clerk who keeps accounts...

Is it his fault? No, blame this court and this system!

Heifu added: "Or do you think it's because you didn't catch up with the good opportunity to make contributions during the unification?"

Many soldiers nodded.

"It doesn't matter!"

Heifu raised his arms and said: "Now, you have encountered a new opportunity! The traitorous minister usurped the throne and wanted to unjustly kill the loyal people. The world is about to change, and we must follow the edict carefully, starting from the grass, starting from the south, and cleaning up step by step Mountains and rivers, reorganize the government and bring order to chaos!"

"This achievement should be no less than the cause of unification. After everything is over, many of the people present today will be able to join the court and become rich and noble!"

He pointed at Xing who was stunned and said: "Xing, you were a small thief from Chu, a prisoner in the county temple, a hidden official in Anlu, and the head of Yuzhang in Guizhou. But you participated in this righteous war, and maybe you can serve as the magistrate and lieutenant of Shaxian County. ! Return home in glory!"

Heifu then pointed at everyone: "No matter you were a butcher, a trumpeter, a peddler, a craftsman, a son-in-law, a prisoner, a soldier, or a petty official, as long as you follow me, you will get a chance!"

"Of course you don't believe the imperial court. The imperial court has broken its promises to the Southern Expedition Army too many times, but you can trust Hei Fu!"

"This time, everyone's contribution will not be wiped out or let down!"

The sound shook the whole country, and everyone bowed their hands towards Hei Fu:

"We believe in you!"

Heifu believes that it is not advisable to use love to generate electricity. Only by changing destiny and life can we give people hope and motivation.

There are two types of slogans for righteousness. One is to inform the world and make oneself justified, such as Heifu's previous instigation and the planned "Edict of the First Emperor".

The second is to tell your own people so that they can participate wholeheartedly. Otherwise, if the three armies are suspicious, everything will fail!

At present, the soldiers may not know the general trend of the world after being encouraged by Hei Fu.

But at any rate, they have understood that this battle is also a fight for their own glory and wealth!

Pointing at Xing, whose face was red with excitement, Heifu asked:

"Xing, are you drunk?"

What excited Xing Shen Zui was not the rice wine, but Hei Fu's promise. He also boldly boasted:

"This villain can drink three measures of wine!"

"Good! Your courage is commendable. This trip to Shaxian is something that only a brave person can do. If you can capture Shaxian City for my general, after you return, in addition to the credit you deserve, I will reward you even more. A stone of rice wine!”

The applause continued, and Xing was ready to go all out: "I dare to ask the general how to attack. Xing is willing to be the general's pioneer and climb Shaxian first..."

"attack?"

He was drunk and his chest was still full of courage. Hei Fu seemed to be drunk as well and started laughing.

"We are Qin soldiers. We are entering Qin City. We should inform the local officials, walk in, eat and drink, and leave. Why attack?"

"What?"

Everyone was stunned. At this time, Heifu had thrown a large number of common talismans commonly used in the army on the ground together with the forged flags.

"Talk festivals? Military orders? I have so many! Some are real and some are fake, but they are all stamped with the seals of the Nanzheng Army and Nanjun. Even the military judge may not be able to tell the real ones from the fake ones!"

Heifu has been immersed in the officialdom for many years and is familiar with the rules of officialdom. In a small county like Shaxian that is not a main road, when a commander from another department passes by, the county magistrate and lieutenants have to rush out to greet him.

He picked a talisman at random: "Wu Chen!"

"promise!"

The young man with many moles on his face accepted the promise. Wu Chen was inspired by Hei Fu and was very excited. He didn't know that in the original history, he could also be a vassal king.

Heifu ordered: "Take Xing and others to Shaxian, pretend to be an army outpost to inspect the horses, and say that we are county soldiers who were ordered to wipe out the bandits in Yunmengze. We suddenly received an order to go east and need to stay overnight. Let the county magistrate , Lieutenant receives this... Sima! Then kill pigs, sheep, chickens, and ducks, and arrange food and lodging for our army!"

…

There are many sandy tidal flats in the water on the shore, and there are many small beads on the river. This is Shaxian (today's Jiangxia District, Wuhan).

A fortress had been built here as early as the Chu State, and several families successively became lords here. After Qin destroyed Chu, Shaxian was established as a county and came under the jurisdiction of Hengshan County. Although there was a dock leading to Nanjun, due to the merger No Chi Road passes by, so the county town has no information and is relatively deserted.

It is not as good as the Zhouling in the west, that is, Chibi, and it is even worse than the newly built Wuchang in the east.

The dramatic changes that took place in the Southern Expedition were unknown here.

Qin Shihuang visited Nanjun and Hengshan and conferred the title of Marquis of Wu Zhong on Hei Fu. It took more than ten years for news to reach this place, but the locals were indifferent. His Majesty the Emperor would not come to their small place anyway.

Even Li You recently confiscated the weapons of 30,000 veterans of the Southern Expedition in Wuchang Camp, and the imperial court sent 5,000 troops to watch Wuchang Camp like thieves. Sha Xian, who was only fifty miles away from Wuchang, also knew about it. A mere six hundred or four hundred stone official had no way of knowing the secrets of the imperial court.

Little did he know that a dark cloud had already enveloped Yun Mengze.

So when Ling and Wei Sha Xian received the news that a group of three thousand Nanjun soldiers were passing through here to stay overnight, they saw that the terms of the talisman were correct and agreed without much thought.

The peace in Shaxian has lasted for more than ten years. Except for a small group of hungry thieves who occasionally came out of the river to plunder, there was no war.

Peace makes people slack, so they never imagined that although this army was indeed dressed in Qin army uniforms, it had already changed its surname to Hei.

"The general is so brave!"

Standing in front of the city gate, Xing did not expect that it would be so easy to break open the Shaxian city gate! I admire Heifu even more.

Wu Chen smiled and said: "I heard Li Cang say that as early as more than ten years ago, during the first attack on Chu, the general was trapped in Linyang. In order to break out of the encirclement, he went deep into the Chu camp and pretended to surrender to gain the Chu general's trust. It is said that The Chu general also asked about Hei Fu's name, but the general was not flustered and answered fluently without any flaws."

"In the end, the general led more than 500 people, risked his life and survived, and defeated thousands of Chu soldiers in one go..."

Thousands of Chu soldiers, this is an exaggerated boast. After all, Wu Chen heard what Li Cang said, and Li Cang heard what Li Xian said. After passing the news a few times, the number of Chu soldiers increased, and that battle , has also become the legend of Heifu.

"And now, it's our turn to create new great achievements!" Wu Chen clenched his fists.

Xing Ze sighed and sighed: "If the general is a thief, he must be a giant thief who dares to enter the hall in broad daylight, take people's property, and then run away!"

At this time, the giant thief Hei Fu came swaggering with his army.

He changed his outfit and was actually wearing the armor of another Sima. Anyway, there were so many similar positions in the Southern Expeditionary Army, so just pick one and be done with it.

As for forging symbols, seals, flags, or even creating a person who does not exist, as a high-level boss in the system who knows the rules of operation, what is the difficulty?

If the commander of the military region rebels, what else can the county armed forces minister do besides stare?

Sure enough, Lieutenant Shaxian, who was one level lower than Sima from other departments, was fooled. He stood at the city gate to greet him enthusiastically. After greeting Hei Fu, he politely said:

"May I ask Sima, how should I be called?"

Heifu also showed an honest and honest smile:

"My name is Yi Xiaochuan!"

…
